claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: Photos show a pallet-style wooden bed frame only; no scale reading, certification, or weight measurement is visible.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added.
claims.evidence: Photos do not clearly show moisture level, treatment against dampness, or any evidence of 'no water added'.

claims.claim: Wooden pallets are the backbone of supply chain logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing, while...
claims.evidence: This is general commentary and does not provide verifiable details about the specific item shown.

risks.risk: Hidden damage/weakness (cracks, loose joints, broken slats, rot, worm holes) that affects load-bearing safety.
risks.proof: A short video from multiple angles showing every slat and joint up close, plus a tap/press test demonstration (hands pushing at corners and center) and a close-up of any damaged-looking wood.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used pallet-style frame with unknown structural integrity (assume possible wear/weak points).

risks.risk: Incorrect fit for mattress size due to unknown overall dimensions and height.
risks.proof: A measuring clip showing length, width, and height with a tape measure (or a known reference object) and confirming mattress size compatibility.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic pallet base with unknown dimensions (assume buyer may need to verify fit).

risks.risk: Missing hardware/fasteners or incomplete assembly parts (bolts, brackets) leading to instability.
risks.proof: A photo/video showing all included hardware laid out, and a close-up of attachment points (holes/brackets) on the frame.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as frame-only with no guarantee of included hardware (assume buyer may need to source fasteners).

risks.risk: Surface treatment/termite resistance not known; risk of infestation or future deterioration.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of wood treatment/finish (varnish/paint/chemical treatment) and any visible insect damage; plus a statement with proof of treatment if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as untreated/unknown treatment (assume higher risk of pests and faster wear).

risks.risk: Stability/load rating not known; pallet-style frames can sag depending on support blocks and slat spacing.
risks.proof: A video showing underside support blocks and slat spacing clearly, plus a load test clip (e.g., one person standing/pressing at center) if safe.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case for sagging/limited load capacity (assume minimal support).

proof_requests: Provide overall dimensions (length, width, height) with a tape measure in-frame.
Show close-ups of every slat and all joints/edges (front, sides, underside) to confirm no cracks/rot/worm holes.
Confirm whether any hardware/fasteners are included; show them laid out and attachment points on the frame.
Show underside support blocks and slat spacing clearly (and how many layers/support points).
If claiming 'clean and dry', provide evidence such as a moisture-check reading or at least photos showing no dampness/odor indicators.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item type as a pallet-style wooden bed frame/base, so it can be priced at its worst case for unknown dimensions and structural condition. Seller weight/moisture claims are not verifiable from the provided images, so the price should assume typical used-frame risks until proof is provided.
